summary: Heavy Rain entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Heavy Rain

emulation.notes: Native Windows route. Use original PS3 hardware only for original-presentation preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at 4K/60 where hardware allows

primary.why: The PC version is optimized for 4K visuals and 60 fps, making it the highest-fidelity official route. The PS3 original remains the historical route for original controller/motion-control presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows/Steam or Epic PC version, record input method and resolution/frame-rate settings, and preserve PS3 only if original motion/control behavior is part of the archive goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record input method because control prompts and interaction feel differ across PS3, PS4, and PC routes.
